name: Calendar
description: Adds timezone-aware calendar features of a date or timestamp column: year, quarter, month, week, day of month, day of week (0 = Sunday), day of year, is_weekend and is_holiday. A timestamp column is treated as UTC and converted to the requested timezone before the date parts are taken; a date column has no time of day. 'holidays' is a list of ISO dates and 'holiday_column' names the boolean flag. The original columns are kept.

column.title: Date column
column.description: Date or timestamp column to derive the features from.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone such as Europe/Moscow; timestamp columns are converted from UTC.

features.title: Features
features.description: Calendar features to add; all except is_holiday by default.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.description: ISO dates (yyyy-MM-dd) that count as holidays.

holiday_column.title: Holiday column
holiday_column.description: Name of the is_holiday flag; defaults to <column>_is_holiday.
